revision_history.reason: Session showed store_memory timeout where agent used memory blocks (working_context, shared_working_state) and task resolution fields as fallbacks — both are viable and actually preferred over CRM notes in many cases (memory blocks are in warmup context; task resolution captures outcome with the task). The existing skill only documented the CRM notes path. Expanded to cover the full fallback hierarchy with priority ordering.

Session revealed the skill only covered store_memory unavailability. A CRM enrichment worker looped for 8+ iterations because create_note and write_file were unavailable — it kept retrying the same calls instead of degrading. Added broader tool-unavailability detection, enriched-contact persistence fallback, hard stop rules, and anti-loop discipline.
